unit_budget.derivation: One complete non-composite owner unit under the approved 60-minute-per-atomic-task policy; any retry remains inside productive execution.

trusted_roots.operator-env-provider: The configured durable local-operator environment provider; represented only by a secret handle

parent_delegation_contract.producer: The active full-test or speed-test parent owner runtime
admission_checks: parent_owner_sequence_id is one of the two allowed parents
parent effect state exists and is STARTED
delegation and child journal ownership exactly match task_id, run_id, branch_ref, and worktree_id
child_owner_sequence_id and child_intent_id match the requested child
blocker_id has a same-path passed verification_event_id
delegation is unconsumed or was previously consumed by this identical child effect_id
delegation consumption and child effect preparation are one atomic journal transition
parent_delegation_contract.rejection_boundary: Reject before budget reservation, argv construction, or any operator call. A caller-supplied parent id or copied delegation payload has no authority without the matching same-journal parent effect and event.

parameter_contract.field_authority: Every value except delegation_id is copied from the durable parent blocker/re-entry state or derived by the child contract; the external caller cannot override it.

effect_and_reconciliation_contract.effect_identity: delegation_id plus parent_effect_id plus mode plus task_guid plus blocked workflow/run identity plus verified blocker correction
effect_and_reconciliation_contract.prepare: Persist the deterministic target run/control identity before the operator call and atomically bind delegation consumption to child effect preparation.

reconciliation.resume: Query the original run. A matching active/waiting/completed post-resume state is ALREADY_APPLIED; the unchanged failed state with no accepted control receipt is NOT_APPLIED; identity disagreement is INDETERMINATE.
reconciliation.restart-workflow: Query deterministic child run identity and task lineage. A matching new workflow run is ALREADY_APPLIED; proved absence with the original blocked run unchanged is NOT_APPLIED; multiple or divergent new runs are INDETERMINATE.
reconciliation.start-over: Query deterministic restarted research-run identity under the same task. A matching new run is ALREADY_APPLIED; proved absence with no accepted start-over receipt is NOT_APPLIED; multiple or divergent runs are INDETERMINATE.

effect_and_reconciliation_contract.resume_rule: An ALREADY_APPLIED running/waiting result returns control to the parent without issuing a second operator action.

common: The operator envelope has no errorCode and does not classify as blocked or unknown.
A durable target run identity is present and belongs to task_guid and the requested/derived workflow.
A semantic state query proves the target run is running, waiting at a recognized gate/clarification, completed, or chain-complete.
The output includes mode, workflow, taskGuid, targetRunId, verdict, finalOk, and errorCode.
Exactly one owner_terminal event and matching terminal artifact exist for child effect_id.

mode_specific.resume: targetRunId equals the requested run_id and the state no longer represents an unacknowledged failed control action.
mode_specific.restart-workflow: targetRunId is a new run of workflow_name under task_guid and upstream task lineage remains unchanged.
mode_specific.start-over: targetRunId is a new research-workflow run under task_guid produced by the acknowledged start-over action.

terminal_contract.source_correction: cmd_reenter must return nonzero for blocked/unknown/error envelopes and must emit targetRunId; its current unconditional return zero and omitted run identity cannot terminalize success.
